messages:
maria (Sales AE): Quick Q from Pinebridge SIG — they asked for 'key rotation proof' for SIG Q12.5. Need a short evidence packet (policy + logs). POC deadline this Friday. cc @olivia (security) @jordan (se)
olivia (Security Engineer): We have a rotation policy page in Confluence and KMS rotation logs in the audit bucket. I can pull an export but need approval before we share production audit extracts. @maria who is the customer contact? any NDA needed? :thinking_face:
maria (Sales AE): Contact is security@pinebridge.com. They explicitly asked for evidence that master keys rotate every 90 days and that app data keys are re-encrypted monthly.
jordan (Sales Eng): For Hosted customers we enable AWS CMK rotation (EnableKeyRotation). For Private we rely on customer KMS/HSM. Pinebridge is 'Hosted with VPC' per POC notes — need to confirm if they're relying on our CMK or managing their own.
olivia (Security Engineer): If they're on Hosted using our CMKs, we can provide the policy doc + CloudTrail events showing EnableKeyRotation calls and periodic RotateKey-related events. I'll prepare a 6-month extract. Any redaction rules I should follow?
sam (Ops): I can run a CloudTrail lookup and export CSV. Command I'll run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time 2024-07-01 --output text` — will need a JIRA ticket to attach the output. Tagging @sec-approvals.
sec-approvals (bot): Reminder: exporting production audit logs requires SR approval. Please submit a security request in JIRA (project SEC-EVIDENCE). Include justification and intended recipients.
maria (Sales AE): Submitted JIRA SEC-EVIDENCE-4311 with a short justification and Pinebridge contact. Please attach a sanitized CSV and a short narrative. ETA for customer handoff: Friday.
olivia (Security Engineer): I'll prepare the export and redact IAM user ARNs and full S3 paths per policy. Plan: attach `rotation_policy.pdf` and `cloudtrail-rotation.csv` to the JIRA ticket. ETA Thursday EOD.
jordan (Sales Eng): Also confirm whether the customer means CMK/master key rotation vs envelope/app data key rotation — SIG Q12.6 sometimes conflates the two. maria, can you confirm with Pinebridge?
maria (Sales AE): Heard back: they want both — proof that provider rotates master keys every 90 days AND that application-level keys are re-encrypted monthly. :grimacing:
olivia (Security Engineer): OK. We'll provide CMK rotation artifacts + a sample runbook and logs showing the monthly app-key re-encryption job. Sam, can you pull the runbook snippet and sample log path (sanitized)?
sam (Ops): Snippet I will include in the ticket:
```
# monthly-key-rotation.sh
python tools/rotate_app_keys.py --env prod --dry-run=false
# logs pushed to s3://redwood-ops/key-rotations/2024-06-01-run-12345
```
I'll sanitize S3 path in the shared document to `s3://redwood-ops/key-rotations/[REDACTED]`.
maria (Sales AE): Good. Security prefers masked paths — customer may ask for raw paths under NDA. I'll note that in the JIRA and request NDA if they insist.
olivia (Security Engineer): Agreed. Include a short narrative in the ticket: what rotation means for CMKs, what the automated job does for app keys, and links to the runbook and policy. If they request raw logs, we'll escalate to legal for an NDA and create a limited-scope temporary access ticket.
jordan (Sales Eng): :thumbsup: For the POC checklist, add: evidence attached (policy + sanitized logs + runbook), owner on call Tuesday, and escalation path for raw logs.
maria (Sales AE): Thanks everyone — I'll update SEC-EVIDENCE-4311 with the artifacts once Olivia and Sam upload. Will mark this thread resolved when customer confirms receipt. cc @legal if NDA needed.
